fields.summary: Autonomous plan run (RHIZA_AUTONOMOUS=1), no owner present. The change set's intent names the bug: session.start's stepPattern (internal/api/session.go) accepts one '/' only and maxStep is 61, so a workflow wrapping ship-change (bugfix) fails at its builder with step "ship-change/build/build". The planner read session.go, internal/workflow/include.go (flattened inner steps are named <workflow>/<step>, so each wrapping level adds a segment) and the precedent change set 01M75RDB, whose bug workflows serve m4-orchestrated-by-rhiza. Planned two leaves under workflow-runs: session start accepts step paths of any depth (segments dashed lower-case words, at most 120 characters), proven by a testscript running a repo workflow wrapping ship-change to its builder session; and run status, inbox, watchdog, journal and Rex tab labels handle 2+ slash step paths. Choices taken as assumptions: serve m4-orchestrated-by-rhiza; 120-character limit as the intent suggests.
fields.title: Nested workflow step paths fix, planned autonomously
